inaugural_issue.rationale: Opens necessarily on Zenodotus' Book-Burning (#1), the archive's first deposit and its founding injury. Then the forensic record of a Wikidata deletion (#5), the Archival Reclamation Protocol (#26) and the Ghost Governance reply (#33) as demand and refusal, provenance adjudication (#41), heteronymy as function not name (#79), attribution survival as a substrate condition (#95), and OCTANG-002 (#84) as the worked provenance collision. The issue is the discipline's own wound, read forensically.
